name: Minecraft-style Static Lighting Algorithm
definition: A two-pass static lighting system baked into chunk mesh vertices. Pass 1 simulates direct sunlight from above. Pass 2 simulates indirect light spread using a multi-pass diffusion algorithm.
summary: This algorithm approximates global illumination in voxel worlds by baking precomputed integer light levels into mesh vertices, offering performance gains for static scenes at the cost of dynamic light support.
